Name: Icky's Chickies ( Chicken Mod )
Author: ichabodmods
Description:
Chickens! So many chickens. I gave the chicks and chickens of all colors a more realistic look. I also included a folder that contains an alternative to the pure white chicken, with black on its feathers.

Place the .xnb files into your Animals directory (Usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals)

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
